interpretation: Assumed-demand operating experiments, not calibrated Pocket Trains profit predictions. Paired ranges describe only the observed synthetic seeds, not confidence intervals. Twelve policy configurations per plan were tuned on separate training seeds; layout geometry was not tuned on evaluation outcomes.

documented: Per-engine job boards refreshed on station arrival, not while waiting
Only yard cargo is shared; no unloading into cargo origin yard
assumed: One identical generic train per active owner, speed 1 distance unit per time unit
Fixed independent one-car offers per arrival; selectable hypothetical destination priors
Uniform 1–4 reward multipliers; reward index uses approximate Mercator city-coordinate separation, not actual coin prices
Route choice uses distance + 40 per owner handoff, with origin transfers forbidden; income objective counts only delivered reward
Patrols use minimum route-inspection walks; cargo-directed policy chooses the next neighboring station by onboard priority
All stations are visited/stopped at; load handling time and shared check-in ticks are configurable
Finite yard capacity; reserved cargo slots permit feasible pickup-before-unload exchanges; yard cargo is prioritized
Optional generic tank and stationary fuel regeneration; no game train statistics are inferred
omitted: Measured destination/job-count probabilities, cargo batch sizes, Bux/crate/event jobs and expiry
Engine-specific speed, capacity, repair costs, electrification, actual fuel, new-railroad/track costs
Player action budget per check-in and manual optimal routing; no automatic construction instructions
